changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 6 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6661-app-launcher-nav-menu-renderers.md`

- names `en.ts` → `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — edited by this change

  > Three new strings — the launcher's and the menu's accessible names, and the menu's empty state — are declared under `console.nav` in `en.ts` and its nine sibling packs. An inline `defaultValue` alone is not a fix: it renders English at one call site and leaves the string untranslatable everywhere (objectui#3517).

### `.changeset/8738-object-form-fields-description.md`

- names `ObjectForm.tsx` → `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx` — edited by this change

  > The registration declared `{ name: 'fields', type: 'array' }` with no description, so an author had nowhere to read that this key's members are **bare field names** — a different vocabulary from `sections[].fields`, which also accepts the spec `FormFieldSchema` object (identity key `field`, e.g. `{ field: 'note', colSpan: 2 }`). Moving one of those objects to the top-level `fields` resolves to no name and is skipped by `SimpleObjectForm` (`ObjectForm.tsx`) and by `buildFlatFields` (`flatFields.ts`, shared by the drawer/modal presentations). Behaviour is unchanged by this entry; it only adds the description text an author would need to avoid the drop before writing it.

### `.changeset/console-form-container-specs-one-declaration-5596.md`

- names `FormPage.tsx` → `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > objectui#5542 converged the LEAF of this contract — the field spec — and left the two containers above it untouched, because converging them was a bigger call than a mechanical import. `FormSectionSpec` and `FormViewSpec` were each hand-declared twice under the same names, once in `packages/app-shell`'s `SchemaForm.tsx` and once in `apps/console`'s `FormPage.tsx`. Unlike the leaf — whose console copy was a clean subset — these two had **already drifted, in both directions**, so neither copy was a subset of the other and there were two live answers to "what may an author write":

### `.changeset/console-form-field-spec-one-declaration-5542.md`

- names `FormPage.tsx` → `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > objectui#5040 was not a missing key. It was that **two hand-written descriptions of one contract drifted**, and nothing could notice, because each was only ever checked against itself. PR #5537 converged the two app-shell descriptions into `views/metadata-admin/form-spec.ts`. A **third** survived in `apps/console`: `FormPage.tsx` declared its own nine-key `interface FormFieldSpec`, under the same name, in a different package — so the same failure mode stayed fully available.

### `.changeset/console-formpage-runtime-default-seed-5727.md`

- names `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` → `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `readPrefill` in `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` seeded every declared default unconditionally. A `defaultValue` may be a literal, or an *instruction* the server resolves per insert — a `DEFAULT_VALUE_TOKENS` token (`NOW()`, `current_user`) or a CEL Expression envelope. Seeding one of those literally put the text `NOW()` into a datetime input on both `/forms/:name` and the public `/f/:slug` route, and submitting it sent that string as the field's value — which is neither absent nor null, so `ObjectQL.applyFieldDefaults` never resolved the declared default and the column stored the token text instead of a timestamp.

### `.changeset/console-formpage-visible-predicates-5594.md`

- names `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` → `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` is a **second, independent form renderer** — its own `buildSections`, its own JSX — and it serves both the public `/f/:slug` route and the internal `/forms/:name` route. It read neither spelling of the FormView field visibility predicate: a repo-wide grep for a `visibleWhen` / `visibleOn` *read* inside that file returned zero. So a field an author conditioned on `record.priority == 'urgent'` — legal, spec-strict metadata that `@objectstack/spec` normalises to `visibleWhen` (ADR-0089), and that the metadata-admin designer both authors and honours — rendered unconditionally on both routes. Fail-open and silent: the author saw the field always, with no diagnostic.

- names `FormPage.tsx` → `apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` — edited by this change

  > objectui#2212 recorded this exact symptom and PR #2214 fixed it — in a **different chain**: `ModalForm` → `resolveFormViewLayout` → `@object-ui/plugin-form` `sectionFields.ts` → `@object-ui/components` `renderers/form/form.tsx`. `FormPage.tsx` is on that chain at no point, and #2212's regression pin lives with the chain it fixed, so nothing in the suite could see this copy. One contract, two implementations, each only ever checked against itself.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `8a5ae3d63` (merge-base with origin/main): 23 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1761 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2367 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36605751327)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ae1166668f07073332fc643c33f4cd030c1191c9`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #11071 (body, triage `5888948751`, claim `5894375674`, os-dev-report `5895386652`), PR #11129 (body, 24-file list, net diff against `main` at the head; merge-base `76e9df06c`, 1 commit ahead), and the head's latest check-runs. Files at the head or the merge-base were read through `contents/PATH?ref=SHA` for context only.

**Check-runs on the head (the gate verdicts):** 43 latest runs, all completed — 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (dependabot, `Test (coverage)`, `Test (coverage shard)`: conditional jobs), 0 failed, 0 cancelled. Type Check, Lint, all eight test shards, Test (dist pins), Build and E2E, Spec Main Shape Gate, Changeset Bump Policy / Declaration / Fixed Group / Claim Re-read / Overwrite Report, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Line Citation Gate and Control Byte Scan are each `success`. The last shard completed at 17:47Z; I waited for it before judging.

### ① Derived judgments

**Console form page (`apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`, through `useObjectTranslation` — the triage direction).** Each site, the key it reads, and whether the choice is right:

1. `Submit` → `publicForm.submit` (reused; en `Submit`, zh `提交`). Right — the key triage named.
2. `Submitting…` → `publicForm.submitting` (reused; en `Submitting…`, zh `提交中…`). Right — the key triage named.
3. `Uploading…` → `fields.file.uploading` (reused; en `Uploading…`, zh `上传中…`). Right — it is the key `uploadGate.tsx` already reads for `busyLabel`, i.e. the in-flight upload label on a form's submit control: the same thing this button says while an upload is pending. No new key was needed.
4. `Redirecting…` → `publicForm.redirectPending` (new). Right — the only candidate, `publicForm.redirecting`, is the embeddable form's countdown `Redirecting in {{seconds}} seconds…` and carries a hole this page has no value for; a different sentence, so a new key. en byte-equal to the literal.
5. `Required: A, B` → `publicForm.requiredFields` = `Required: {{fields}}`, the labels joined with `validation.formInvalidJoiner` (en `, `, zh `、`). Right on both counts. The joiner key is the en pack's own separator for a list of field labels after a colon (its comment says so), so its meaning is the one used here; en output is byte-identical to the old template literal `Required: ${labels.join(', ')}`. The dev's refusal of `wizard.missingRequired` is right: that key is `Please complete the required fields: {{fields}}` — a different sentence — and reusing it would change the page's English and break the pre-existing `Required: Priority` pin in `FormPage.sharedWidgets-10179.test.tsx`. One frame key with a hole, not a concatenation, so colon, spacing and word order belong to the pack (zh renders `必填项：Title、Priority`, pinned).

**plugin-form (through the family's `createSafeTranslation` tables).** `MasterDetailForm` and `ObjectForm` read `useFormChromeTranslation` (`formChrome.ts`); `ModalForm`'s changed site sits inside the component that holds `useDiscardTranslation`'s `t`, and the new row was added to that table. Every default row is byte-equal to its en value (`check:i18n-keys` holds them; the dev ran it green and Lint is green on the head). The fallback `t` in `useSafeTranslation.ts` interpolates `{{holes}}` through `interpolateFallback`, so the provider-less English path fills `{{rate}}`, `{{title}}` and `{{row}}` — the pre-existing provider-less pins (`MasterDetailForm.saveInFlight` asserting `Saving…`, the `detailDeriveFailure` / `detailSchemaFetchFailure` DEGENERATE CONTROLs asserting `Loading columns…`) still hold, and all eight shards are green.

6. `Loading columns…` → `form.masterDetail.loadingColumns` (new). Right.
7. `Subtotal` / `Tax (N%)` / `Total` → `form.masterDetail.subtotal` / `.tax` = `Tax ({{rate}}%)` / `.total` (new). Right; en byte-equal, the rate is the record's.
8. `Line item — row N` → `form.masterDetail.rowTitle` = `{{title}} — row {{row}}` with `form.masterDetail.lineItem` = `Line item` filling the title when the collection has none (new). Right; an authored `title` still fills the hole (CONTROL pinned).
9. `Apply` → `form.masterDetail.applyRow` (new). Right.
10. `Add` (in-form collection default) → `detail.add` (reused; en `Add`, zh `添加`). Right — the detail family's add verb, the same meaning; authored `addLabel` still wins (CONTROL pinned).
11. `Close` (row editor) → `common.close` (reused; en `Close`, zh `关闭`). Right — the same verb, the same button role. Scope judged in ③.
12. `Saving…` (Save in flight) → `detail.saving` (reused; en `Saving…`, zh `保存中…`). Right — the in-flight save label, the same meaning.
13. `ModalForm` master-detail sr-only description → `form.masterDetail.editorDescription` (new). Right; an authored dialog `description` still wins (CONTROL pinned).
14. `ObjectForm` `deniedDescription` → `form.deniedDescription` (new), read once as a string and added to the `useMemo` dependency list. Right; a field's own `description` still wins (CONTROL pinned).

**Keys and packs.** 11 new keys (`form.deniedDescription`, the eight `form.masterDetail.*`, `publicForm.redirectPending`, `publicForm.requiredFields`), the same 11 in each of the ten packs, checked mechanically over the diff; every translation keeps its holes (`{{rate}}`, `{{title}}` + `{{row}}`, `{{fields}}`); en values are byte-equal to each literal replaced. The i18n init runs with `escapeValue: false` (`i18n.ts`), so moving authored labels and titles into interpolation holes changes no output for values carrying `&` or an apostrophe. `check:i18n-drift` reports 0 en values changed.

**Measured-before-changing (the source-read-only half).** The dev measured every listed site under zh at the parent commit and reports each rendered English; the pins encode the same measurement (every zh case red in the ablation, the already-localised `取消` untouched and not asserted). Direction honoured.

**Pins.** `FormPage.chromeI18n-11071.test.tsx`: zh submit / in-flight / uploading / pending-redirect / refusal on page and toast / two-label joiner, CONTROL authored label inside the frame, en byte case. `formChrome.i18n-11071.test.tsx`: zh totals, placeholder, in-form Add and the row editor (title, Apply, Close), in-flight Save, modal description, locked-field hint, with CONTROLs for authored `title` + `addLabel`, dialog `description`, field `description`. `FormPage.chromeI18n-11039.test.tsx` now submits through `提交` / `Submit` instead of `/Submit/` — the move triage ordered. A zh render per site plus an authored-override control: present.

**Five console test harnesses** (`FormPage.avatarUpload-10785`, `.fileField`, `.recordObject`, `.serverDefaults`, `.sharedWidgets-10179`): each gains one `createI18n` en line in `beforeEach`; no assertion changes. Harness-only surface extension, named in the report and the PR; judged in ③.

**Public surface and accept-set.** No export of `@object-ui/plugin-form` changes (`FORM_CHROME_DEFAULTS` is module-private; `NAVIGATE_ON_SUCCESS_REFUSED_NOTE` and `useFormChromeTranslation` unchanged); no prop, type or schema moves; `@object-ui/i18n` gains 11 additive keys; the console is an app. No accepted value set moves anywhere. English output byte-identical. The commit carries the model-free trailer pair objectui AGENTS.md prescribes; no model identifier in the PR body, the changeset or the diff.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/11071-form-chrome-remainder.md`: `@object-ui/console` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `@object-ui/plugin-form` patch.
